copy.headline: Frogs Head to Lubbock for Thanksgiving Showdown
copy.caption:
TCU Athletics Frogs Head to Lubbock for Thanksgiving Showdown TCU heads to Lubbock for a Thanksgiving night showdown vs. Texas Tech. The Battle for the Saddle will air nationally on ESPN.

It will be the 68th all-time meeting between the two schools in a series that dates back to 1926.
